evidence_boundary: Action terminal + independent typed SkillGoalEvidence matched to explicit SkillTerminalCriterion
positive: SATISFIED plus granted matching authority -> existing SkillExecution.succeed
negative: VIOLATED plus granted matching authority -> existing SkillExecution.fail
uncertain: UNDETERMINED or UNKNOWN Action -> no Skill terminal transition
authority_owner: SkillExecution (existing); explicit caller SkillTerminalAuthority as gate
limitations: Goal evidence, status, reference, time, and terminal authority are supplied by a trusted caller, not independently cryptographically authenticated
Different provenance refs are not proof of physical-world causal independence
One bounded second-epoch Skill only; no multi-Action controller evaluation
Action OUTCOME is not an assertion of success, and Skill success does not close Current Intent
No automatic event admission, Skill completion, learning, or Epoch 3
No new Skill/Action/World owner and no Paper2 MAIN40 reinterpretation
